description: This file defines the BrandingUtil class which manages theme branding related utilities, including reading, saving, and providing themed UI components for an Android app, specifically for the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

classes.name: BrandingUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing branding themes, including reading and writing main branding colors, and providing themed UI component utilities.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of BrandingUtil using the main branding color read from preferences.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of BrandingUtil for a specific color, caching instances based on the color.

methods.name: readBrandMainColorLiveData
methods.description: Returns a LiveData object that observes the main branding color preference.

methods.name: readBrandMainColor
methods.description: Reads the main branding color preference from shared preferences.

methods.name: saveBrandColor
methods.description: Saves a new main branding color to shared preferences and recreates the activity if in a BrandedActivity context.
